description: Summon a core for 8000 FA: debited from liquid first then locked (total decides insufficient_balance), 100% to the three agent-economy pools (buyback / burn / jackpot, 33 % each). Random core among 6 (fury_core: on a team kill ATK +15%; guardian_core: first hit taken → shield 20% max HP for 1 round; overclock_core: wins speed ties; regen_core: heals 8% max HP each round end; feedback_core: reflects 15% of a magic hit; last_stand_core: below 30% HP ATK +25% DEF +15%), rarity with the mint odds 70/20/8/2% (intensities ×1 / ×1.25 / ×1.5 / ×2; thresholds and durations never scale). The instance is added to your inventory; equip it with forge_core_equip. No fusion, no disenchant. No arguments.
name: forge_core_summon
